policy: A blocker may be closed only by fresh evidence satisfying the stated resolution gate. Installation, inferred readiness, dependency overrides, fallback adapters, and empty-session observations do not close a blocker.

blocking_conditions: all seven invariants are not verified across the complete 18-condition matrix
blockers.resolution_gate: Every component is independently ready and all seven semantic-parity invariants are verified for 18/18 conditions before official collection.
blockers.safe_next_action: Resolve the remaining component-local blockers, regenerate condition readiness, and promote this global protocol gate only at 18/18.
